profile_headline: Data Scientist | Craves to Learn | Loves to Solve | Lives to teach
post_content:
Rejections are common. Everyone gets it. Recently I got rejected for
'teaching' a recorded course in Data Science. And the reason is - I faltered
during the demo. During my introspection, I realized that I am not a garden
mower to work seamlessly and then come back after a week and mow again. I am a
driller of an oil rig. I dig in depth. When I teach concepts, I aim at 100% of
students understanding from zero. Only when you go to depth, you need not
revise again for every interview - my belief So a driller takes breaks and it
pauses as well. But once a hole is made, its only another hole pending.
